map_info.name: Facade_Rustication
map_info.description: The surfaced expression of facade assembly. The principle's six moves preserved, but the rustication axis is *dialled up to maximum semantic load* — Naples-style diamond-bossed surface, every stone block carved into a pyramid that projects outward. Hierarchy is preserved (heavy at the base, lighter above), bay rhythm regular, but the *texture is the argument*. Smooth ashlar at upper storeys; diamond bossing at the ground. Surface as voice.

learning_objectives: Recognise the rustication axis as a load-bearing compositional move
Read surface texture as semantic content, not just material
Identify the defensive-decorative double of diamond bossing as Naples-specific architectural argument
